internal.title: Incident Summary: Checkout Service High Error Rate Due to Payment Failure Flag
internal.body:
At 10:42 UTC, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the checkout service. Diagnosis identified the root cause as an error injection in the payment service caused by the 'paymentFailure' flag, which led to invalid token errors and increased latency in checkout. The flag was disabled at 11:01 UTC after approval, resulting in recovery and normalization of error rates by 11:02 UTC. The incident was resolved promptly with no lasting impact on service availability.

Timeline:
- 10:42: Alert received for high error rate in checkout.
- 11:01: Diagnosis confirmed payment error injection due to 'paymentFailure' flag.
- 11:01: Flag disable command proposed and approved.
- 11:01: Flag disabled.
- 11:02: Verified recovery with normalized error rates.

Next steps include reviewing flag deployment procedures to prevent recurrence.

external.body: Between 10:42 and 11:02 UTC, some customers experienced issues completing checkout due to a payment processing error. Our team identified and resolved the issue by disabling a problematic configuration flag in the payment system. The service has returned to normal operation. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
